verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a bank-data aggregator could plausibly offer end users a consent-management portal. Nothing in the pack documents an end-user surface for viewing or revoking app access. The docs cover only Link (a linking component), Dashboard customization for developers, and data products. The one community item (plaid-comm-2) is a user asking how to cut off Plaid's access, which shows uncertainty rather than any documented capability.
